title: Machine learning guides trace-element additions in anaerobic digestion
summary: The predicted mixed trace-element strategy raised cumulative methane production by 18.40% over the control in batch tests, and was also tested in semi-continuous experiments. The work is lab-scale.
ai_technology: Stacked CatBoost, LightGBM and XGBoost models with Bayesian optimization used to inverse-design trace-element addition

evidence.unknown: Abstract only; lab-scale; full text not reviewed.
